title: Allergy Symptom vs Pollen Correlation
dataSources: Posture readings (`posture:reading`), symptom logs (`symptom:log`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), sneeze events (`sneeze:event`).
app: Everyday body-signal logs — posture sensors, symptom and allergy journals, hydration-linked bathroom logs, and quirky personal counters — sent to Splunk HEC via wearables, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=symptom:log OR sourcetype=purpleair:aqi)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(eval(if(sourcetype=="symptom:log",severity,null()))) as symptoms, avg(pollen_index) as pollen by _time
| sort - _time
description: Lines up your allergy symptom severity against pollen and air-quality readings to find your real triggers.
value: Matching symptoms to environmental data pinpoints which days and triggers to prepare for with medication.
implementation: Join symptom logs with air-quality/pollen data in `index=personal`; trend both together.
visualization: Dual-axis chart of symptom severity and pollen index.
grandmaExplanation: It lines up your allergy symptoms with pollen levels to work out what actually sets them off.
